notes.title: KingdomScape v0.9.0 is now out
notes.content:
Added


Added new card type - God Cards. These purple-colored cards provide powerful bonuses to your kingdom when played

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44986084/b1c478fb40deb6afda5712ff1f7c263bffafeb6a.png

Every 10 turns, you must pay tribute in FAITH since you started worshiping a god.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44986084/818e0e7232ff2fffbc8ca7429d03b01b8683eeb5.png

Failing to pay the required FAITH will result in losing the bonuses provided by the GOD card.

notes.title: KingdomScape v0.8.1 is now out
notes.content:
Added


 Added semi-transparent background added to in-game tooltips and resource icons for better visibility.



Fixed


 Fixed the issue where the Monk card was playable with only 1 POPULATION, resulting in GAME OVER.
 Fixed the issue where order progress was not updating properly.

notes.title: KingdomScape v0.8.0 is now out
notes.content:
Added


 Introduced Order quests that spawn randomly from level 50. These quests must be completed within a time limit, rewarding resources if successful, or causing resource loss if failed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44986084/8893a9bcb1a03992b998768d0243bf4576e1de80.png

 Added hover animation for Blessings.
 Updated log messages with green and red colors to indicate resource gains and losses.


Changed


 Modified Farm card effect: Changed from "Get 3-5 FOOD" to "Get 3-6 FOOD."
 Modified Rainbow card effect: Changed from "Get 1-2 HAPPINESS" to "Get 1-3 HAPPINESS."
 Modified Bandit Camp card effect: Changed from "Get 3 WOOD and 1 GOLD for every 1 ARMY you have" to "Get 2 WOOD and 1 GOLD for every 1 ARMY you have."
 Reduced the chance for extra HAPPINESS and POPULATION from high LUXURY.


Fixed


 Resolved an issue where the army upkeep cost in gold was not being deducted correctly when the GOLD was lower than the required upkeep cost.
 Fixed an issue where the Tavern card messages were not being logged.
 Corrected the Dragon card effect. Now, you lose half of your housing as described, instead of half plus one when HOUSING is an even number.

notes.title: KingdomScape v0.7.1 is now out
notes.content:
Fixed

 Fixed bug with blessing card effects not working

notes.title: KingdomScape v0.7.0 is now out
notes.content:
Added

 Introducing new cards type: BLESSING that provide additional resources for a limited number of turns. Blessings scale with level and housing.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44986084/f4674792ff2f5c692ba40da9973f57e7c5f9e41f.png

Changed

 Updated card hovering effect for a smoother animation.
 Updated card colors to darker shades of green, red, and blue.


Fixed

 Fixed the resolution of in-game images. Challenges, Modifiers, and Resource Icons now look clearer.

notes.title: KingdomScape v0.6.0 is now out
notes.content:
Added

  Added How to Play section
  Added new effects for high resources:


     High IRON may turn into ARMY
 	High CLOTHING may turn into LUXURY
 	High WOOD and STONE may turn into HOUSING
 	High MAGIC may produce HONOR

  Added new modifiers:


 	Opulent Estates
 	Dark Magic
 	Exquisite Tailoring
 	Prosperous
 	Industrial
 	Mystic
 	Trade Hub
 	Militaristic
 	Pious
 	Strategic Location
 	Rebellious
 	Fertile Lands


Fixed

 Fixed an issue where modifiers appeared as deselected after playing a game, despite being selected.

notes.title: KingdomScape v0.5.0 is now out
notes.content:
Added


 Added new challenges and corresponding steam achievements


Changed


 Reduced chance to drink beer and wine

notes.title: KingdomScape v0.4.0 is now out

 Changed the outline of resource icons from white to black

 Fixed a bug with the Beehives card where food was taken instead of being rewarded when the card is played
 Fixed a bug with the Alliance card where the army was set to 5 instead of being increased by 5 when the card is played

notes.title: v0.2.0
notes.content:
Added


 Added description box on Upgrades screen showing how much HONOR points are required for next level of upgrade
 Added new cards: 


 	Cave (Get 1 LUXURY for every 3 ARMY you have.)
  	Royal Army (Give 30 ARMY. Get 3 HONOR.)
 	Bandit Camp (Get 3 WOOD and 1 GOLD for every 1 ARMY you have.)





Changed


 Lowered base "BAD EVENT" chance
 Lowered "BAD EVENT" chance increase per level
 Lowered "GOOD EVENT" chance increase per level
 Changed Cookhouse card description: 
     From "Requires 10 POPULATION. Give up to 10 FOOD. Get double amount of FOOD." 
     to "Requires 10 POPULATION. Give up to 10 FOOD. Get double amount of FOOD given.",
     to clarify the card effect


Fixed


 Fixed Warmonger challenge description: "AMRY" changed to "ARMY"
 Fixed Bonfire card name: "Bonefire" changed to "Bonfire"
